A fix for updates.

### What's changed
- **Printing carries on after an update.** Updating with **Update now** pauses the print queue while it installs, so nothing prints mid-update. Until now the queue stayed paused once the program reopened, and new cards waited for someone to choose **Resume printing**. The queue now carries on by itself, unless a card needs checking.

Existing installs keep all their templates, clients and people.

### Updating
An administrator will see **Version 3.0.7 is available** at the top of the program — choose **Update now**. Or download the setup below and run it over the top.

### New install
Download **ID-Card-Printing-Software-Free-Setup-3.0.7.exe** below and run it. The setup isn't code-signed, so the first time Windows may show *Windows protected your PC*: choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**, then **Yes**.
